reference.title: 5 things to build with AI, in order (levels roadmap)
reference.notes: Speaker at a desk with poker chips + a knight as the level marker; neon level orbs between two hands; white-grid UI boards with lime stickers; paper reveal/orbit/shatter posters; photo inserts with hand labels. 45 scene changes (~0.54/s). Clone (ishaan-motion): data/refs/r2/clone-motion.

parts.name: Two-tier key word
parts.about: 1-3 words: the strongest word (longest non-stop word, numbers first) big and heavy, the words before it small above, after it small below; each word arrives on its own stamp

parts.name: Hand label with a self-drawing arrow
parts.about: a condensed hand-written label lands, then a curved arrow draws itself to the thing it names, with a two-stroke head

parts.name: Photo with a hand label
parts.about: a full-frame photo (colour, then black and white) with a slow push; on the b/w one the name is written on and an arrow draws to the person; an app icon pops on 'he built'

parts.name: Article card with a highlighter
parts.about: a press-style article card drops in beside the speaker, grows on the number, and a yellow highlighter swipes the claim

parts.name: Numbers counting across the top
parts.about: each spoken number slams in across the top in the display face (18, 19, 20), then the unit words tuck under the ends

parts.name: Reveal poster with a face cut-out
parts.about: on paper, three stacked display lines slam in red, one per word, and a round face cut-out pops over the middle line

parts.name: Tool icons orbiting a face
parts.about: a ring draws round a face cut-out and tool icons pop onto it one by one, then keep orbiting slowly

parts.name: Words shatter into shards
parts.about: dots fall into place, a badge pops, the threat words slam in, then on the last word they break into seeded shards that blow away to one side

parts.name: Floating project card with a label
parts.about: an app screenshot card floats beside the head, swapping on each spoken example; a condensed PROJECT N label and a hand arrow point at it; the last one is blurred (the one you have not built yet)

parts.name: Desk chips with a knight marker
parts.about: five poker chips on the desk count down 5..1 above them; a chess knight hops to the chip of the level being talked about; a chip lifts when its level is named

parts.name: Neon hands holding the level orb
parts.about: two glowing violet hands hold an orb; the level's number flips up out of a row of numbered discs like a coin and becomes the orb with the level's name; finished levels shrink to small labelled discs on the left

parts.name: Coin flip
parts.about: the frame turns over like a coin: squeezes to an edge and opens on the new side

parts.name: Pixel-block dissolve
parts.about: the next shot appears in 60 px blocks in a seeded order over about 4 frames

parts.name: Vertical whip with smear
parts.about: the insert arrives from below at speed with ghost copies along its velocity (motion blur)

parts.name: White grid board with UI cards
parts.about: a white board with a faint grid; UI cards (a prompt box typing, a landing page, a chat, a profile page) rise in on firm springs

parts.name: Lime sticker label
parts.about: black condensed caps on a lime box, stamped on with a spring and a slight tilt on its word

parts.name: Mini game frames
parts.about: a tic-tac-toe card draws its X; three game frames pop in a row as the score ticks, ending on a game-over card

parts.name: Icons pop around the head
parts.about: white round icons (user, data, idea) pop around the speaker's head on their words and keep floating

parts.name: Black card, lime display type
parts.about: a hard cut to black; the key words slam in lime, the phrase building word by word

parts.name: Dive onto the desk
parts.about: the camera dives in log space onto a prop on the desk while everything goes soft (depth of field), on the line's low point

uses.role: whoosh on inserts and the dive
